abstract: Benign cystic ovarian teratoma is not an uncommon tumor, but its presentation as a bleeding rectal polyp has not been reported previously. A case report and review of the English medical literature are presented with emphasis on the cause, clinical presentation, and management of benign cystic ovarian teratomas with colorectal involvement.
abstract_ja: 良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫は珍しい腫瘍ではないが、直腸出血性ポリープとして発症した例はこれまで報告されていない。本論文では症例報告と英語文献の総説を行い、大腸病変を伴う良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の原因、臨床像、治療について検討する。
